paragraphs.text: Therefore seeing they did not obey the commandment of God, they were justly cast from the land which they had only on condition.
paragraphs.label: b
paragraphs.anchor: observe to do according to all

paragraphs.text: Meaning, that whoever hears of this great plague, will be astonished.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: As I have destroyed Samaria and the house of Ahab so will I destroy Judah.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Meaning, Judah and Benjamin, which were the only ones left of the rest of the tribes.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: The Hebrews write that he slew Isaiah the prophet, who was his father-in-law.
paragraphs.label: s

paragraphs.text: That is, according to his commandment.
paragraphs.label: g
